name: abcoda
description: Interactive ABC music scores for AI conversations, built with MCP Apps.

scripts.build:worker: npm run build:widget && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc --outdir ../../dist/worker
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:widget && wrangler dev --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.lint: eslint packages apps tests/unit tests/worker tests/browser playwright.config.ts scripts/verify-artifacts.mjs scripts/verify-deployment.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:widget && npm run test:worker && npm run build:worker && npm run verify:artifacts
scripts.check:browser: npm run check && npm run test:browser
